description: This file defines a global navigation service for a Flutter application. It provides methods to navigate without a BuildContext, using a global navigator key to push routes and pop to the root before pushing a new route.

classes.name: NavigationService
classes.description: A singleton class providing static methods and a global key to facilitate navigation actions without requiring a BuildContext.

methods.name: pushNamed
methods.description: Pushes a named route onto the navigator stack if the navigator is available.

methods.name: popToRootAndPushNamed
methods.description: Pops all routes until the first one, then pushes the specified named route.
